item.tib: sa lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa legs bshad nor bu 'dren pa'i gru gzings
item.coloph: ces sa lam gyi rnam bzhag nyung bsdus 'di yang / rang 'dra'i rtsom pa mkhas pa'i dbang por son pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bab pa'i mchod sprin du mi 'gyur mod na yang / gzhung lugs chen por 'jug mi nus shing brtson 'grus zhan pa/ blo chung zhing khong dge ba rnams spro bsring ba'i ched dang yang khyad blo gsal gyi slob grogs sngags 'chang ge los 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul rkyen bgyis ngor/ gshen btsun gyi tha shal ba puN+ya shI lar 'bod pa bdag gis rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po gshen rab nyid sku 'khrungs nas sku gsung thugs bstan pa mi lo nyis khri nyis stong bdun brgya bcu gnyis 'das pa'i legs sbyar ba'i dza ya ma hA tsi na'i gya wu rang cag gi rgyal ba zhes pa shing mo lug gi bzhin ras ngom pa'i hor zla gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i srog dbyangs ram 'char ba'i zla tshes la dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
